description: AutoSA space-time choice and the manual flags. Reads sa_sizes and the compiler command. Does not rewrite a GEMM netlist.

skills.pattern: a matrix-multiply search is running all six space-times as if the paper reported all of them
skills.strategy: Designs 1-6 are space-time 0-5 in order: i, j, k, (i,j), (i,k), (j,k). The paper's MM case study reports designs 1, 4, and 5 only, which are space-time 0, 3, and 4, on 1024^3 float.
required_steps: map design 1 to space_time 0, design 4 to space_time 3, design 5 to space_time 4
treat space-time 1 as the symmetric partner of 0, and space-time 5 as the symmetric partner of 4
keep a separate campaign row for any space-time outside 0, 3, and 4
guards: do not describe space-time 2 or 5 as one of the three reported MM designs
the exact 13x16x8 and 13x12x8 tilings were not in the earlier 1024^3 HLS set

skills.pattern: space-time 2, 4, or 5 is generated without the reduction flags and codegen stops or emits the wrong reduction
skills.strategy: When k is a space loop, pass --local-reduce --reduce-op=+ --simd-touch-space. Those are space-time 2, 4, and 5. dse_config.autosa_flags_for_space_time appends them from reduction_space_times.
required_steps: leave those flags off for space-time 0, 1, and 3
guards: do not put the reduction flags on an output-stationary array

skills.pattern: --array-contraction is applied to space-time 0 or 3, or it is omitted on space-time 2, 4, or 5
skills.strategy: The manual adds --array-contraction only for Arrays 3, 5, and 6. It contracts local_C when the time loops are parallel. Output-stationary arrays keep the local C buffer and drain it.
required_steps: do not pass --array-contraction for space-time 0, 1, or 3
guards: space-time 0 and 3 generate C_drain_IO modules; space-time 4 and 5 generate C_IO modules
